images.name: tablet
images.prompt: Museum studio photograph of an ancient Sumerian clay tablet: a small rounded slab of warm terracotta clay covered in neat rows of tiny wedge-shaped impressions, chipped corners, seen slightly from above. Soft even studio light, sharp focus.

images.name: barley
images.prompt: A 19th-century botanical steel engraving of a sheaf of barley stalks tied with twine, long whiskered ears of grain, drawn alone with nothing behind it. Fine black cross-hatching, antique encyclopedia illustration, black ink.

images.name: jar
images.prompt: A 19th-century steel engraving of an ancient Mesopotamian clay beer jar with a wide mouth and two small loop handles. Fine black cross-hatching, antique encyclopedia illustration, black ink on white paper.

images.name: press
images.prompt: A 19th-century steel engraving of a 15th-century wooden hand printing press with a massive wooden screw and a long iron lever, three-quarter view. Fine black cross-hatching, antique encyclopedia illustration, black ink on white paper.

images.name: printer
images.prompt: An engraved portrait in the style of a 16th-century woodcut of a bearded German printer in a fur-trimmed robe and a soft cap, half-length, proudly holding up a freshly printed blank sheet of paper. Fine line engraving in black ink.

images.name: typewriter
images.prompt: A 19th-century steel engraving of an 1870s typewriter with round keys on long levers, a cylindrical platen and an ornate cast-iron frame, three-quarter view. Fine black cross-hatching, antique encyclopedia illustration, black ink on white paper.
